query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.role, 
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient_therapist_assignments WHERE therapistUserId = u.id) as patients_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments WHERE therapistUserId = u.id) as appointments_count
FROM users u 
WHERE u.role = 'therapist' 
LIMIT 3;
